1.explanation:
All of the logic for attaching a native title attribute to individual Cascader options lives in these three files:

• src/cascader/cascader.jsx – the root component that instantiates the drop-down, passes props (including any new `showItemTitle` flag) down to the menu and items.

• src/cascader/menu.jsx – renders each column of options (each <ul> or <li>) and currently unconditionally passes the item.label into the title attribute on the DOM node.

• src/cascader/item.jsx – responsible for rendering the individual option contents and also applies the title attribute directly on the element by default.

To add a prop that disables titles, you’d need to modify both `menu.jsx` and `item.jsx` to only set `title={...}` when the prop is true (default), then thread that prop through in `cascader.jsx`. Finally, update `types/cascader/index.d.ts` so TypeScript users can see and type the new API prop.
1.bug_scenario: In the current Cascader implementation every menu item automatically renders a native “title” attribute (and shows the browser tooltip) whenever its label is too long and is ellipsized via CSS. Even if you pass a completely custom itemRender, the title attribute is still applied to each <li> or <span>, so you see the full text tooltip on hover. The user wants an API (for example a prop like `showItemTitle={false}`) to turn off all of these title attributes and prevent the default tooltip from ever appearing.

2.explanation:
• src/cascader/item.jsx: This file is where individual options are rendered (with a `title={label}` on the wrapping element). To disable titles you must alter this component’s logic to respect a new prop.
• src/cascader/menu.jsx: Constructs the panels and delegates to item.jsx. If you add a prop to disable titles, you need to pass it through here.
• src/cascader/index.jsx: The entry point for Cascader, where you would define and forward the new API prop (e.g. `showTitle`).
• src/cascader/utils.js: Contains the default `itemRender` helper. If title disabling interacts with custom renders, you may need a small adjustment here.
• src/tree/view/tree-node.jsx & src/tree/index.jsx: Tree nodes also carry title attributes by default. To provide a consistent API for both components, update the rendering of Tree nodes in these files.
• types/cascader/index.d.ts & types/tree/index.d.ts: Update the TypeScript definitions to declare the new API prop (e.g. `showTitle?: boolean`).
2.bug_scenario: In the current Cascader (and Tree) implementation every option node is rendered with a native “title” attribute set to its label. As a result, even if you supply a custom itemRender (e.g. wrapping your label in a <span> without a title), you still see the browser’s default tooltip on hover. The user wants an API prop (for example removeTitle or showTitle={false}) to opt out of adding that title attribute entirely.
